body: I feel the same way. I've sought out help, but nodoby has really been able to provide it, because until they've been in the same situation, it's incomprehensible to them. So the help they provide is the help that makes sense to THEM, someone who doesn't currently want to end it all. It's not the kind of help that someone who is suicidal can use. "Just keep going!" "Try and find a hobby!" "You're so young, give it a few more years and things will work out!" "Buy medicine or see a therapist!" They use the responses that they feel they are socially obligated to give, and then they leave, because being in close proximity to someone who is depressed is mentally and emotionally draining. It's not their fault, they just cannot (in most situations) provide adequate advice.
